title: Who Each Snowsports School Product Is Taught To: Ages, Group Sizes and Subjects Offered
content:
Every Snowsports School product is written for a particular participant: an age range in whole years, an ability level, a discipline, a language and a mountain, taught in a group of a stated size. This page carries those conditions product by product.

## Ages and group sizes

The youngest age in whole years at which a participant may be booked into a product, the oldest, the largest number of participants one instructor takes, the smallest number at which the product still runs, and whether the participant must hold a season pass, stand as follows.

| Product | Youngest age | Oldest age | Largest group | Smallest group | Season pass required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 15 | 85 | 8 | 3 | no |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 7 | 14 | 6 | 3 | no |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 3 | 6 | 4 | 2 | no |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 7 | 17 | 8 | 4 | yes |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 7 | 85 | 3 | 2 | no |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 3 | 85 | 1 | 1 | no |
| Elite Performance Camp | 12 | 19 | 6 | 4 | yes |

## Ability levels, disciplines, languages and mountains

| Product | Ability levels taught | Disciplines taught | Languages delivered in | Mountains run at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | beginner, novice, intermediate, advanced | alpine skiing, snowboarding | English, Spanish | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | beginner, novice, intermediate | alpine skiing, snowboarding | English, Spanish | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Copper Hollow |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | first timer, beginner | alpine skiing | English | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow |
| Six-Week Development Programme | intermediate, advanced | alpine skiing, snowboarding, freeride | English | Granite Ridge, Silverpine Basin |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | novice, intermediate, advanced, expert | alpine skiing, snowboarding, telemark | English, Spanish, French | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow |
| Private Instruction Full Day | first timer, beginner, novice, intermediate, advanced, expert | alpine skiing, snowboarding, telemark, adaptive | English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow |
| Elite Performance Camp | advanced, expert | alpine skiing, snowboarding, freeride | English, French | Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak |

## Points of judgement drawn from the two tables

- A child of six falls inside the Mountain Cubs Group Lesson, whose range runs from 3 to 6, and inside the Private Instruction Full Day, whose range runs from 3 to 85; a child of seven has passed out of the Cubs range and falls inside the Mountain Explorers Group Lesson, whose range runs from 7 to 14.
- Telemark is carried by two products only, the Semi-Private Coaching Session and the Private Instruction Full Day; adaptive is carried by the Private Instruction Full Day alone.
- Japanese and German are carried by the Private Instruction Full Day alone.
- Two products are written for participants who already hold a season pass: the Six-Week Development Programme and the Elite Performance Camp.
- The Private Instruction Full Day takes one participant, so its largest and smallest group sizes both stand at 1.
